summary: Added opt-in persistent grid-stride execution to the existing standard MoE GEMM1 path while preserving persistent=False as the default and retaining its API and mathematical behavior. Verified default and persistent modes against independent Torch references on gfx950 for all supported input dtypes and masked tails.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=/job/repo FLYDSL_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9870aaa06078/cache/runtime /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9870aaa06078/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_moe_gemm_2stage.py -k 'test_moe_gemm1_numeric or test_moe_gemm1_sentinel_token0' -q -s
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before baseline of the unchanged standard GEMM1 implementation: 20 existing numerical and masked-tail tests passed on gfx950. Persistent mode was not yet present.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=/job/repo FLYDSL_RUNTIME_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9870aaa06078/cache/final-tests /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9870aaa06078/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_moe_gemm_2stage.py -k 'test_moe_gemm1_numeric or test_moe_gemm1_persistent_numeric or test_moe_gemm1_sentinel_token0' -q -s
tests.what_was_measured: 28 GPU tests: unchanged default behavior plus persistent fp8, int8, int8smooth, and int4 correctness for tile_m 16/64 and masked tails, against independent Torch references.

On identical inputs, default and persistent correctness plus seven warmed timing batches of 100 launches for two masked-tail shapes and all four supported input dtypes; raw means, standard deviations, minima, maxima, and samples are in persistent-gemm1-validation.json.
Python syntax and patch whitespace validation. Ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter.

remaining_limitations: Only two synthetic shapes were timed; this is not a production-model performance qualification.
Persistent mode was neutral within variability once and slower in the other measured pairs, so it remains opt-in and no speedup is promised.
No C++ native compiler source changed, so the documented pinned native rebuild was not required.
